The actual common-module constructor performs its one optional Platform lookup only inside the real public isDevMode guard. Genuine public Platform is the exact registered token; absent services yield null, development provider errors propagate, production performs no lookup, and outside-context construction retains that same development/production distinction. Existing untouched-original check-body and constructor-factory regressions pass (three tests). The stripped module decorator/import initialization and high-contrast body behavior are separate obligations; protocol sanity inputs and version values do not qualify them. Genuine complete original16.2.12/main22.1.7/21.2.23 namespaces execute both development and production scopes: 54 assertions, ten source counterexamples and twelve runtime mutation rejections. Public nondeprecated inject/object-option typing is independently bound to the prior current-context proof, without adding a whole-class compilation claim. Public Platform/DOCUMENT objects execute; service/document/version values are explicit protocols. No complete module/application/node graph, native/packed/AOT, Cyph build, full Node/RxJS/compiler floor or G11 clearance. No product, consumer markup, CSS or SCSS change.
